case.title: Midnight Masquerade at the Alpine Chalet
case.introduction: A glamorous gala is underway at Snowcrest Alpine Villa, perched on a snow‑capped mountain. The host proudly displays a priceless sapphire necklace, but as the night deepens the jewel vanishes, and the guests must uncover the thief before the snowstorm seals the mountain pass.
case.crime: The priceless sapphire necklace disappears from its display case during the evening gala.
case.escape_plan: Victor will slip into the hidden ski‑lift tunnel behind the library bookshelf and escape to the mountain base before the storm blocks the road.

rooms.name: Lobby
rooms.description: A grand entry with marble floors, a roaring fireplace and a coat rack where guests leave their outerwear.

rooms.name: Main Hall
rooms.description: The centerpiece of the villa, illuminated by chandeliers and showcasing the sapphire necklace on a velvet pedestal.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.description: Shelves of rare books line the walls; a secret passage behind a movable shelf leads to the ski‑lift tunnel.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: A bustling professional kitchen filled with gleaming copper pots, a prep island, and a back door to the service alley.

rooms.name: Balcony
rooms.description: An outdoor balcony overlooking the snowy slopes, equipped with a small table and a smoking area.

characters.name: Victor Delaney
characters.personality: Charismatic and smooth, always with a perfect smile
characters.background: Arrived from New York to discuss a joint venture with the villa owner, claiming interest in rare gems
characters.secret: He is actually Evan Marsh, a wanted art thief who plans to steal the sapphire necklace
characters.goal: Steal the necklace and escape before the storm cuts off all exits
characters.alibi: Was in the library reading a book at 9:30 PM

relationships.detail: Met briefly while discussing the gala menu

knowledge: Knows the hidden ski‑lift tunnel behind the library
Familiar with security camera blind spots
lies: Claims to be a legitimate investor
Denies any knowledge of the necklace’s location

characters.name: Lena Kovacs
characters.personality: Passionate, meticulous, and fiercely protective of her kitchen
characters.background: Head chef hired to prepare a multi‑course dinner for the gala
characters.secret: Owes a large sum to a former mafia patron who might pressure her
characters.goal: Earn a huge tip and keep her reputation spotless
characters.alibi: Was in the kitchen prepping desserts at 9:30 PM
knowledge: Saw Victor leave the library clutching a small bag
lies: Says she didn’t see anyone near the necklace

characters.name: Professor Amelia Hart
characters.background: Invited to speak about the history of the sapphire necklace
characters.secret: Had a secret affair with the villa's owner, giving her privileged access to the collection
characters.goal: Publish a definitive book on the necklace and its legend
characters.alibi: Was in the main hall admiring the necklace at 9:30 PM

relationships.detail: James hired her to verify the necklace’s authenticity

knowledge: Knows the exact weight and cut of the sapphire
lies: Denies any romantic involvement with the owner

characters.name: James Whitaker
characters.background: Hired privately by the villa owner months earlier to look into possible thefts
characters.secret: His investigation report implicated a former associate who now works as a security guard elsewhere
characters.goal: Uncover the thief during the gala and protect his client’s reputation
characters.alibi: Was on the balcony smoking at 9:30 PM

relationships.detail: Consulted Amelia about the necklace’s provenance

knowledge: Noticed a shadow linger near the ski‑lift tunnel entrance
lies: Claims he saw nothing unusual on the balcony

timeline.description: Guests arrive and gather in the lobby, cocktail hour begins
Dinner is served in the main hall; the sapphire necklace is unveiled on a velvet pedestal
Security cameras start rolling; the chandelier lights flicker briefly
Lights dim for a brief intermission; each guest claims an alibi
A guest reports a figure in a black coat slipping out of the library
The sapphire necklace is discovered missing; panic spreads
Investigation begins; characters start questioning each other

evidence.name: Glove imprint on display case latch
evidence.description: A clear imprint matching Victor's black leather gloves

evidence.name: Security camera footage
evidence.description: Shows a figure in a black coat exiting the library at 9:32, holding a small bag

evidence.name: Torn apron fragment
evidence.description: A piece of a chef's apron found near the display case; matches Lena's uniform

evidence.name: Broken lockpick
evidence.description: A lockpick snapped in half, discarded in the kitchen trash; similar to Victor's set

evidence.name: Fingerprint on balcony rail
evidence.description: Partial fingerprint that matches James' notebook cover

hidden_clues: The movable bookshelf in the library can be pushed to reveal a narrow tunnel leading to the ski‑lift shaft
A faint draft near the library shelf indicates the tunnel is not sealed
red_herrings: Lena's claim that she saw Victor but later admits she was distracted by a kitchen fire
James' statement that the balcony shadow was just a passing skier’s silhouette

solution.reasoning: Victor's alibi fails because security footage shows him leaving the library at the crucial moment, and his glove imprint on the case latch directly links him to the theft. The lockpick in the kitchen matches his set, confirming his involvement. The torn apron and balcony fingerprint are decoys designed to mislead, but they do not match any other evidence. Victor planned to use the hidden ski‑lift tunnel behind the library to escape, which aligns with his knowledge of the passage and his escape plan.

state.current_objective: Identify the hidden target among the suspects.
